column3: Baptist churches (Southern Baptist, independent Baptist, Reformed Baptist and others): believer's baptism by immersion, local-church autonomy.
Methodist, Wesleyan, Nazarene and Holiness churches: Arminian on salvation, emphasis on holiness and Christian perfection.
Presbyterian and Reformed churches: Calvinist on salvation and election, covenant theology, infant baptism.
Church of England, Episcopal Church and other Anglican churches: historic liturgy, bishops, infant baptism.
Assemblies of God, Church of God and charismatic churches: baptism in the Holy Spirit, spiritual gifts today including tongues and healing.
